# Commercial Due Diligence: UK Mid-Market CDD Scope, Fees and 7-Chapter Spine

> Independent reference for UK commercial due diligence: 7-chapter report spine, published UK CDD contract awards (£41,500 to £300,000), scope template, 11-day playbook. Methodology sourced to ICAEW Guideline 72, BVCA and ONS.

- [Top-Up Commercial Due Diligence: Scope and Fee Off VCDD Reliance](https://commercialduediligence.co.uk/types/top-up): Top-up CDD covers incremental work a buyer cannot rely on the seller's VCDD adviser for. Timeline 2-4 weeks; the fee is quote-only.
- [Vendor Commercial Due Diligence (VCDD): Reliance Mechanics and Fees](https://commercialduediligence.co.uk/types/vendor-vcdd): VCDD is commissioned by the seller pre-process and delivered to bidders with reliance. Fee is quote-only. Buyer reads it as evidence, not endorsement.
